details:
To better protect player privacy, VRChat should introduce an optional "Do Not Track" setting on user profiles. When enabled, this status should be included in the VRChat API and logs so that third-party applications, such as VRCX, can recognize and respect the user's preference.

This setting would not prevent other players or applications from displaying information that is currently visible in-game. Instead, it would prevent participating third-party applications from permanently storing or building a history of that user's activity, including:

- Instance changes and travel history

- Location or movement data

- Profile, biography, or status changes

- Previous usernames or profile information

- Any other temporary information observed through VRChat

Information needed for the current session could still be processed and displayed, but it should be discarded once it is no longer required. Users should not be able to retrieve historical information about someone who had "Do Not Track" enabled when that information was observed.

VRChat should publish clear technical rules for this system. Publicly distributed third-party applications that use the VRChat API should be required to honor the "Do Not Track" status by avoiding persistent storage of protected user data and deleting temporary records when they are no longer needed.

This would give players meaningful control over how their activity is recorded without limiting normal, real-time social interactions in VRChat.
title: DoNotTrack Profile
